score.Game score: Personal performance vs your baseline for this single game (0–100, letter tier). Independent of win/loss. Expand a category to see the metrics behind it.

key_stats.gd10: Your total gold minus your lane opponent's at the 10-minute timeline frame, averaged across games.
key_stats.deaths: Average deaths per game in the window.
key_stats.deaths_pre14: Average deaths before minute 14 (end of the laning phase).
key_stats.dpm: Average damage to champions per minute: total champ damage ÷ game length.
key_stats.damage_share: Average share of your team's total damage to champions each game.
key_stats.gold_share: Your gold as a share of team total gold each game.
key_stats.vspm: Average vision score per minute (Riot vision score ÷ game length).
key_stats.control_wards: Average control wards bought per game.
key_stats.objectives_present_rate: Share of epic monster takes (dragon, herald, baron) where you were near the pit.
key_stats.solo_deaths: Share of deaths with no allies within roughly three-quarters of a screen (≈2200, or ~5–6 flashes).
key_stats.greed_deaths: Share of deaths shortly after deep side-lane pushing without nearby allies.
key_stats.fights_disadvantaged: Joined fights where the enemy had more nearby champions.

objectives.Taken: Whether your team secured this epic monster.
objectives.Present: You were within range when the objective was taken.
objectives.Split pushing: Absent at the pit but applying offensive sidelane tower pressure. Only counts after 14 minutes, or earlier once a tower has fallen on your lane.
objectives.Defending split: Holding your tower under enemy split pressure while the team contests.
objectives.Absent without pressure: Absent at the objective without sidelane pressure or a defend.
objectives.Traded for: Your team traded this objective for structures on the map.
objectives.Held tower: You successfully held a tower during this objective contest.
objectives.Bad trade: Structures lost outweighed the objective value.
objectives.Manpower at pit: Ally vs enemy count near the objective pit at take time.
objectives.TP available: You had Teleport in range but stayed on your sidelane assignment.
objectives.No TP: No Teleport available — absence may be excused by summoners.
objectives.Died in setup window (45\u201310s): You died in the 45–10s setup window before this objective was taken (caught before the fight; last-10s teamfight deaths are excluded).
objectives.Wards before: Average wards you placed in the 2 minutes before each objective take. Any ward type counts; map location is not filtered.
objectives.Wards during setup: Wards you placed within 2 minutes before the objective was taken, only shown when you were present at the pit.

key_moments.interpolation: Drag the scrubber to step through minute snapshots from just before the action through just after. Riot records all ten players once per minute. Objective icons are bright when up, dim when taken.
key_moments.gold_given: Kill bounty + shutdown gold from the Riot kill event — the gold pot awarded for your death before assist sharing.

rules.note: Every goal reads the same rolling window, and a new block only counts games played after it appeared.
Hit the target in 15 games of the window and the goal clears. All three goals count at once, so a strong run clears the block in one window.
Drop below 11 of 20 and a cleared goal is revoked — the block cannot complete until you re-earn it.
Each rung is computed from your own distribution and capped at a reachable step, so clearing a block moves the next one up.

legend.name: Locked
legend.text: Not measured yet — this block sits to the right of the live one, so nothing in it counts until it becomes live.

legend.name: In progress
legend.text: Live and counting. The ring fills as you hit the target in more of the last 20 games; reach the clear bar of 15 and it clears.

legend.name: At risk
legend.text: Cleared, but drifting. You are still above the hold bar of 11 of 20, so it stays cleared — one or two bad games and it is revoked.

legend.name: Cleared
legend.text: Held at or above the clear bar across the current window. Counts toward the block; the other goals in it are counting in parallel.

legend.name: Revoked
legend.text: Was cleared, then fell below the hold bar. It goes back in play and the block cannot complete until you earn it again.
